lane_title: Chi across-strike sign-reversal + slope-break + basin gate
hypothesis: Buried intrabasin scarps offset drainages and reorganize upstream catchments, yielding a signed chi step across strike even where surface scarp is eroded; chi contrast is hydrologic, independent of potential-field or radiometric layers.
mechanism: chi_u8 step_max (sigma 2px, opposite-side 300m contrast, max over 4 dirs) × percentile-ranked slope-break Hessian ridge (sigma 1.5, band19) × basin depth gate (0.3+0.7*rank(depth_to_base_surf)); directional NMS crest pool; greedy spaced emission 3.5px, >3px from catalogue, border 6px; 37654 dots; binary float32 on exact sample grid.
named_non_fault_process: Lithologic knickzone or volcanic flow margin producing chi step without coincident slope-break; pluvial shoreline bench at constant elevation.

data.external: data/external/dem10_chi_100m_u8.tif (4-band u8 chan_n/knick_n/raised_n/valid_n) restored by scripts/restore_inputs.py, hash-verified

method.chi_cleaning: median-impute outside footprint, smooth sigma 2px, no catalogue use
method.chi_step: max_{dirs}(|chi(+3px)-chi(-3px)|) over (3,0),(0,3),(2,2),(2,-2), both flanks in footprint
method.slope_break: Hessian ridge max-eigenvalue magnitude of det_elev_slope, sigma 1.5
method.emission: greedy descending surface, stable tie-break, grid-hash spacing, exactly 37654 if pool sufficient else fallback to surface-ranked eligible
method.output: binary float32 on exact mirrored sample grid; all finite, zeros outside, nodata None

evaluation.metric: vendor/gems57/evaluate_holdout.py pooled_summary alpha 0.2 beta 0.8 radius 300m triangular
evaluation.promotion_rule: Beats current best on identical folds with paired positive CI AND passes uniqueness (like-for-like discriminating, literal dense disclosed) AND format gates; otherwise negative, DO NOT SUBMIT, no slot spent.

uniqueness.dense_prior_literal_policy: FAIL-CLOSED: 17GEMSDOE positive everywhere => every nonempty candidate has literal forward overlap 1.0; reported separately, not silently exempted; discriminating sparse overlap is informative but literal gate is binding.
uniqueness.source: registry/inventory.json + sibling_inventory.json + already-published docs/downloads TIFFs; not private/organizer-complete

limitations: chi_u8 is quantized index not calibrated chi; step is index contrast
owner-mirrored inputs not authenticated to organizer
